mapper.select: SELECT bt.blog_post_id FROM blog_post_tag bt JOIN blog_tag t ON t.id = bt.blog_tag_id WHERE t.slug = #{tagSlug}
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM blog_post_tag bt JOIN blog_tag t ON t.id = bt.blog_tag_id WHERE bt.blog_post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY t.name
